request.style: English, deep male baritone with warm choir, harp, piano, cello, french horn, ethereal mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The outer gate facing east is shut tight
The Lord has entered and left it sealed
No one shall walk through that narrow door
Only the prince may sit in the room
He enters by the vestibule way
And eats the bread before the Lord

[Chorus]
I am their possession, their inheritance
No land in Israel is given to them
The best of the firstfruits are theirs
A blessing rests on the house of Israel

[Verse]
Glory filled the house and I fell down
Mark well the statutes with your eyes
Enough of abominations, house of Israel
Foreigners entered and profaned the house
You broke the covenant with blood and fat
Levites who strayed bear their guilt
They serve as guards at the temple gates
Slaughtering offerings to serve the people

[Chorus]
I am their possession, their inheritance
No land in Israel is given to them
The best of the firstfruits are theirs
A blessing rests on the house of Israel

[Bridge]
But the sons of Zadok kept the charge
They come near to offer fat and blood
Wearing linen garments in the inner court
No wool upon them while they minister
They teach the difference holy and common
Judging disputes by my ordinances

[Outro]
I am their possession, I am their inheritance
